Priya, Vanessa —

Initial read of the trace (kv_trace_0605.html) and server-side logs shows repeated small-window evictions on the prefix KV cache and a surge of head-of-line (HOL) blocking on batch lanes. Concretely: long-tail requests are repeatedly evicting hot prefixes, which causes repeated KV cache reloads and stalls the batch assembly for other requests. That explains both the latency increase and rising 5xx (timeouts when assembly exceeds lane deadline).

Immediate suggestions:
- Temporarily lower per-request max tokens to reduce KV pressure (client-side).
- Increase prefix-KV TTL and bump hot-entry eviction threshold at the model pool level (server-side config).
- If possible, shift some traffic to the dedicated variant (lower parallelism) while we stabilize.

I'll prepare a short config patch we can apply as a hotfix (increase KV window from 8s->30s for the affected pool and raise max_batch_wait_ms from 50 -> 120). We need approval to apply to the shared hosted pool for your region — Vanessa, can you greenlight?

Also: I'll produce flamegraphs and the lane-queue snapshot to INF-1147 by EOD.

—Marcus
